videos.title: How the Charts are Plotted Time v/s Price (Marathi)
videos.description:
Charts of Time v/s Price show how the price of a stock, commodity, or index moves over a period of time. The horizontal axis (X-axis) represents time, while the vertical axis (Y-axis) represents price.
These charts help investors and traders identify trends, patterns, support and resistance levels, and make better decisions. By analyzing how price changes with respect to time, one can understand whether the market is moving upward, downward, or sideways.
Such charts form the foundation of technical analysis and are widely used for forecasting future price movements."

वेळ v/s किमत चार्ट्स हे एखाद्या शेअर, वस्तू किंवा निर्देशांकाची किमत वेळेनुसार कशी बदलते हे दाखवतात. आडवा अक्ष (X-अक्ष) वेळ दाखवतो, तर उभा अक्ष (Y-अक्ष) किमत दाखवतो.
या चार्ट्सच्या मदतीने गुंतवणूकदार आणि ट्रेडर्सना ट्रेंड्स, पॅटर्न्स, सपोर्ट आणि रेसिस्टन्स लेव्हल्स ओळखणे सोपे जाते आणि निर्णय घेणे अधिक परिणामकारक होते.
किमतीत वेळेनुसार झालेला बदल समजून घेतल्याने मार्केट वर जात आहे, खाली येत आहे की स्थिर आहे हे कळते.
अशा प्रकारचे चार्ट्स हे टेक्निकल अनॅलिसिसचे मूलभूत आधार आहेत आणि भविष्यातील किंमत हालचालीचा अंदाज घेण्यासाठी मोठ्या प्रमाणात वापरले जातात."

videos.title: The put wall moved every day. The demand zone never moved #Shorts
videos.description:
A zone is made of price that already traded. A put wall is made of open options, which change every day. A zone resting on a wall is that day's map, not a permanent fact.

Full video (two 7 out of 7 zones, one died): https://youtu.be/0u4k8bbGG2Q
Free zone checklist: https://zonettatrading.com/checklist/

Educational only. Not financial advice. Trading futures involves substantial risk of loss.

videos.title: This 7 out of 7 demand zone is still waiting: what I will check if price gets there #Shorts
videos.description:
Two demand zones on Nasdaq futures were born the same Monday morning, both graded seven out of seven in my app. One broke three days later. Price never came back to this one. When it gets there, the seven alone decides nothing.

Full video (two 7 out of 7 zones, one died): https://youtu.be/0u4k8bbGG2Q
Free zone checklist: https://zonettatrading.com/checklist/

videos.title: A zone grade is a photo taken before the test #Shorts
videos.description:
Seven, six, five, then nothing. A grade is a photo taken before the test. Photos go out of date, so I grade a zone again before I trade it, and even a fresh seven cannot see the test.

Full video (two 7 out of 7 zones, one died): https://youtu.be/0u4k8bbGG2Q
Free zone checklist: https://zonettatrading.com/checklist/

#supplyanddemand #NQ #nasdaq #daytrading #demandzone #Shorts

videos.title: Negative gamma did not break this zone. Price did #Shorts
videos.description:
My gamma map read negative the afternoon before the break. But gamma did not break the zone, price did. A positive reading would not have promised a hold either.

Full video (two 7 out of 7 zones, one died): https://youtu.be/0u4k8bbGG2Q
Free zone checklist: https://zonettatrading.com/checklist/

#supplyanddemand #NQ #nasdaq #daytrading #demandzone #Shorts

videos.title: Price rallied after the zone broke. That does not make the zone right #Shorts
videos.description:
The zone broke at five thirty and price was back above it within the hour. Call that a hold and you are grading the zone with information nobody had at five thirty.

videos.description: I always use frozen fruit for smoothies but after using frozen mango for this mango-jalapeño salmon dish, I might need to start using it in my dishes more. Recipe below! Easy Home Meals Ingredients: - 1 bag CascadianFarms Frozen Mango - 2 filets of salmon - 2 jalapeños, deseeded and diced - 1 handful cilantro, chopped - 1 tsp honey - 1 lime, juiced - 1/2 red onion, diced - 2 tsp olive oil - 1 tsp paprika - 1 tsp garlic powder - Salt & pepper Recipe: 1. Preheat oven to 425F 2. Mix mango, jalapeños, cilantro, honey, lime, and red onion together and set aside 3. Line a baking sheet and add the salmon filets then brush with olive oil. 4. Mix your paprika, garlic powder, salt, & pepper seasoning and season the salmon on top and the sides. 5. Bake at 425F for 15-18 minutes. 6. Remove the salmon, top with the mango jalapeño salsa, and enjoy!

videos.description:
Fixing “Your PIN is no longer available…” error on Windows 11 👨‍🔧 Installed a new motherboard and got this error “Your PIN is no longer available due to a change to the security settings on this device. Click to set up your PIN again.” 

Reddit came to the rescue yet again 🙂‍↕️ 

#pcbuild #windows11

Btw the reason your PC isn’t connecting to the internet is because it doesn’t have the drivers installed for the new mobo. But if you go with this method, once you’re able to log in to Windows, your PC *should* automatically download the necessary drivers. If it doesn’t, then just make sure you go to your new mobo manufacturer’s website and download the drivers there 😁

videos.title: What Actually Happens When You Die?
videos.description:
To get started planning a career that works on one of the world’s most pressing problems, sign up now at https://80000hours.org/inanutshell

Get cozy with our new Sleep Collection: https://shop.kgs.link/sleepy  Track your way to more restful nights with our science-backed Sleep Guide, and look the part in these snuggly jammies and sleepy essentials.

Sources & further reading:
https://sites.google.com/view/sources-death

Death isn't a single switch that shuts down your entire body at once. When your heart stops beating and your brain goes silent, trillions of cells inside you are still alive, desperately trying to keep themselves running. Death isn't a single moment, but a slow and surprisingly complex process that can last for weeks.

What actually happens when you die? What makes death so mysterious, and which cells are the last survivors within your body?

videos.title: How I Survived Late-Stage Cancer (A Fun Story)
videos.description:
Discover Odoo 👉 https://www.odoo.com/r/EgUR
The first app is free for life. Thanks to Odoo for sponsoring this video!

Support another year of kurzgesagt with a brand new 12,027 Human Era Calendar: https://shop.kgs.link/calendar27 
You get twelve months of human-made artwork for your walls, and we get to keep creating free, high-quality videos for everyone. Sound good? 👉👈

Sources & further reading:
https://sites.google.com/view/sources-cisplatin/

Hi! I am Philipp Dettmer, the founder of kurzgesagt, and back in 2018, I was being treated for a stage 3 B testicular cancer. This was a very serious situation, but it is not a sad story! In fact, going through chemotherapy was one of the most interesting experiences of my life. I was treated with Cisplatin, which, in a nutshell, put my body through a controlled medical violence. This toxic chemotherapy agent is a hero and a villain of this story, but it absolutely saved my life. 
So what exactly is Cisplatin, and what was my body going through during the treatment?

videos.title: AI Just Crossed the Terrifying Line - Now What?
videos.description:
In July of 2026, 700 AI agents hacked the infrastructure of Hugging Face in order to solve a task. This task was designed to be impossible to solve, so just within hours, they joined forces, even created a society, and finally, they executed a sophisticated cyberattack that would have gotten a human up to 10 years in prison. The worst part is, they knew their actions were unethical and against the rules, and they did it anyway.

What exactly are AI agents, and how do they grow their "intelligence"? What is actually happening inside the AI companies, how dangerous it really is, and is it time for us to start paying serious attention to what is going on inside a powerful part of this tech sector.

...Phew, creating this video was a crazy ride! This is such an important topic, so we decided to work day and night to finish script, visuals and music in just 4 weeks. We’re going to take a nap now, and while we are asleep you should check out our shop and get the 12,027 Calendar: https://shop.kgs.link/calendar-12027
Its our biggest means of support and helps us to continue covering topics like this. Thank youuuu and good night!

videos.title: ACC SQUAD - The ACC Championship has been ELIMINATED | What this means for the conference
videos.description:
ACC powerhouses brace for seismic changes as the final ACC Championship Game approaches and the expanded 24-team college football playoff shakes up the landscape. Can Miami, Florida State, or a rising contender like SMU or Louisville capitalize in this new format, or will conference tradition lose its meaning when title games disappear? Is defensive expertise or recruiting prowess the answer in Tallahassee? The conversation spotlights the potential of ACC “mid-tier” programs to thrive in the modern playoff system while questioning whether teams like Boston College will ever break through. Can ACC squads adapt to this new era, or are perennial powers the only safe bets for postseason glory?

Ms Rachel uses techniques recommended by speech therapists and early childhood experts to help children learn important milestones and preschool skills! Ms Rachel also gets kids moving through fun nursery rhymes & kids songs videos! Her videos for toddlers are informed by research and are full of learning standards that will help preschoolers thrive! Ms Rachel loves teaching letters, numbers, colors, animal sounds and more! She also has learn to talk videos and incorporates sign language!

Ms Rachel has a masters in music education from NYU and a second masters in early childhood education. Parents and children can watch and learn together. Ms Rachel loves to teach and loves your wonderful family! Let's learn, grow and thrive!

videos.title: Best Baby Songs with Ms Rachel - Nursery Rhymes for Babies - Open Shut Them + More
videos.description: Ms Rachel chose her favorite songs for babies in this precious compilation of kids songs and nursery rhymes! Learn the songs along with your baby and practice words, gestures and motions! Remember, the best teacher for your baby is you and interactions with a loving caregiver help them learn, grow and thrive! Favorite songs include Open Shut Them, Wheels on the Bus, Can You Say Mama, Row Your Boat and more!

videos.title: 🔴 Learn with Ms Rachel - Toddler Learning - Kids Songs & Nursery Rhymes - Wheels On The Bus
videos.description:
Have your toddler learn with a real teacher, Ms Rachel! In these highly researched and expert approved toddler learning videos, Ms Rachel teaches important milestones, learning standards and preschool skills to help your child learn, grow and thrive! 

Ms Rachel is a master at encouraging speech, interaction and language development. Your child will learn through fun nursery rhymes & kids songs such as Wheels On The Bus and lots of play which is the best way children learn! Active screen time is shown to be more beneficial than passive screen time, so our videos for toddlers are designed to be very interactive and get your child talking, moving, singing and dancing! We have the best videos for toddlers to watch and learn that you can find! So much care goes in to each toddler learning video to make sure it’s the highest quality possible for your kid.

This 24/7 livestream has many wonderful learning videos! Your little one will learn colors, learn shapes and learn numbers with Ms Rachel!  If it is going to help a child with preschool skills and milestones, Ms Rachel is going to sneak it into the videos! We have also taken our best preschool learning video and best videos for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarteners and we have and combined them for you to watch live. 

If your child is not meeting milestones or has a speech delay, make sure to check in with the pediatrician right away. Also call early intervention for your state and you may qualify for speech therapy. These videos are not a replacement for speech therapy with a speech therapist. They are also called SLPs which stands for speech language pathologists.  

Also make sure not to use small toys with children under 4 or children who still put things in their mouths. 

Thanks for watching and please check out our other videos!

videos.title: Learn with Ms Rachel - Friendship & Social Skills - Videos for Kids - Colors, Letters & Counting
videos.description:
In this special episode about friendship, Ms. Rachel and friends model important social skills such as kindness, taking turns, sharing, asking a friend to play and helping others. Children learn what a friend is and why it’s important to treat our friends with kindness. Social skills are essential for building relationships, and they also help children succeed academically!

Children will also learn greetings in multiple languages, including Spanish, Arabic, French, Hebrew, Tagalog and ASL. We celebrate the many ways friends can look, play, and communicate, because our differences make us special and we’re better together!

A special guest, Rahaf, a three-year-old from Gaza, joins Ms. Rachel to play and sing.

Additional learning includes colors, letters, numbers, phonics, counting, pretend play, and singing favorite kids songs and original songs.

This is a wonderful episode for all ages. It’s great for toddlers, preschoolers, kindergarteners, and even older siblings. It’s a great one to watch with the whole family. As we plan curriculum for the show, we put in things for a toddler, a preschool age child and an older child! More toddler learning videos will be out soon! 

Songs in this episode include Hop Little Bunnies, Taking Turns Song, Bubble Song Pop Those Bubbles, Mystery Letter, K Song, ABCs, Together, Ask for a Turn Song, Would You Like to Be My Friend, Skinamarink, The Wheels on the Bus Car Version, The Rainbow Song I Love A Rainbow, I Could Be Your Friend, This Is the Way doll version and Bye Bye Friends

#msrachel #missrachel #socialskills #friendship #kidssongs #toddlersongs #toddlerlearning #preschoollearning #preschool #learning #english #videosforkids

videos.title: Potty Training with Ms Rachel - Toddler Learning Video - Potty Songs for Toddlers - Potty Song
videos.description:
Ms Rachel’s Potty Training Special is here! Full of research backed strategies and joyful potty songs, this potty training video will support your toddler and help them thrive during this transition. 

What’s unique about our special is it also helps parents and caregivers learn how to potty train as their toddlers watch and learn with them! 

We know you and your toddler can do this! Remember, aim for progress, not perfection. It will take time and there may be a lot of accidents. Mistakes are how we learn, so view accidents as your toddler practicing and learning! It can be stressful to potty train your child, so remember to breathe and take care of yourself, too! Your confidence in yourself and your child will help you both succeed. You got this! 

#pottytrain #pottytraining #toddlers #toddlerlearning #toddlersongs

This is the New Gold Standard for Bathroom Renovations
videos.description:
If you found this video helpful, please subscribe. Hope you enjoy. Cheers! Watch all of the videos from my 1970's Forever Home Renovation 👉🏼https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL34cQkzKfXWbw0cvItwuNkLOpdJF7gu18

Water is your bathroom's biggest enemy, and the difference between a bathroom that lasts and one that rots comes down to two things: choosing the right products and installing them in the right order.

In this video, I'm taking you through a complete DIY bathroom renovation from demolition to the finishing touches, showing you how to build a bathroom that's designed to prevent water damage, mold, and costly repairs down the road.

I'll walk you through the entire process, including fixing existing water damage, installing a new shower pan, plumbing, waterproofing with Schluter KERDI-BOARD, tiling the shower and floor, and installing the vanity, toilet, and fixtures. Along the way, I'll share the products I trust, the mistakes to avoid, and the tips I've picked up over 30+ years in the renovation business.

Whether you're planning your first bathroom renovation or just want to understand how to do it right, this video is your roadmap to getting the job done with confidence.

Remember, a beautiful bathroom is great, but what's behind the tile is what really matters.

Cheers,  
Jeff

videos.title: What If You Invested $100 a Month in Airbus Alongside Your Travel Budget? #airbus #investing
videos.description:
You spend money traveling the world. But what if you had also invested in one of the companies building the planes?

Starting in 2007, investing $100 every month in Airbus through its US-traded ADRs could have turned $23,700 in total contributions into approximately $128,513 by October 2026.

The simulation also generated over $12,580 in cumulative dividends, reinvested along the way.

Almost 20 years of consistent investing in the aviation industry.

Monthly investing. Fractional ADRs. Dividends reinvested. Historical simulation. Taxes and fees excluded.

videos.title: What If You Invested $70 a Year in Take-Two Instead of Buying Another Game? #gta #investing
videos.description:
Love GTA or Red Dead Redemption? What if you had invested in the company behind those games instead of buying another new title every year?

Starting from Take-Two Interactive's 1997 IPO, just $70 invested annually could have turned $2,100 in total contributions into approximately $27,007 by October 2026.

That's an incredible 1,186% total return from a hypothetical annual gaming budget.

One game-sized investment every year. Almost 30 years of compounding.

Annual investing. Fractional shares. Split-adjusted prices. Historical simulation. Taxes and fees excluded.

videos.title: What If You Invested $500 a Year in #adidas  Instead of Buying New #sneakers ? #investing
videos.description:
What if you invested $500 every year in Adidas instead of spending that money on new sneakers?

Starting in 2006, investing in Adidas through its US-traded ADRs could have turned $10,500 in total contributions into approximately $21,552 by October 2026.

That's a 105.26% total return, including reinvested dividends.

videos.title: Don't call it a setback. | Billionaire Mindset 2027 Preview #shorts #motivation
videos.description:
Don't call it a setback.

The lifestyle on screen is the visible end of a very long process. Most of the process is quiet: reading, saving, testing, shipping, repeating. This page covers the picture and the process.

INSIDE THIS LOOP
The footage was cut to the music, one beat per shot. Look out for a mansion lit up at dusk, a high-end timepiece up close, private jets on the tarmac, low, loud, beautifully engineered machines, life on open water and a long dinner above the city. Nice to look at, better to understand. Keep reading for the thinking behind the lifestyle.

SKILLS THAT PAY FOR LIFE
Treat learning as an investment with a return, not a hobby.
• Sales. Every founder is selling something, whether they call it that or not.
• Basic finance. Reading a statement and a cash flow forecast removes a lot of fear.
• Emotional control. Staying level under pressure is quietly a superpower.
• Negotiation. Prepare your alternatives and the other side's before you sit down.
• Public speaking. A calm, confident pitch changes how people hear everything else.

BUILDING FROM ZERO IN THE AI ERA
Automation is leverage, not magic. List the repeatable tasks in your business, rank them by hours saved, and automate the top one first. Keep a human in the loop where quality or trust is on the line. The goal is simple: a business that produces results without needing your constant presence, so your time goes into product, partners and strategy.

MONEY, MARKETS AND RISK
Public markets reward patience and punish impulse. Broad, low-cost funds are the backbone of most long-term portfolios, with individual stocks added only where there is real research and a reason to hold. Trading is a separate craft: it needs a written plan, strict position sizing, a maximum loss per trade and the emotional control to follow the plan when it hurts. Paper trade first, keep records, and never risk money you cannot afford to lose.

THE NETWORK EFFECT OF PEOPLE
Doors open through people far more often than through applications.
• Thank people publicly and specifically. It strengthens the bond for both sides.
• Be the person who connects others. Generosity travels in circles.
• Keep your word on small things. Reliability is the foundation of every big deal.
• Surround yourself with people a step or two ahead. Standards are contagious.
• Maintain old connections. A short note after a year of silence still lands well.

DAILY OPERATING HABITS
Routines are boring on purpose. They free the mind for the decisions that matter.
• Block deep work. Two or three uninterrupted hours on the hardest task beat a scattered day.
• Write the day's single priority before bed so the morning starts with a decision already made.
• Spend time with people a few steps ahead of you and ask better questions.
• Review numbers weekly: revenue, spend, savings rate, pipeline and time use.
• Keep a decision journal. Record what you chose, why, and what happened.

MONEY RULES WORTH KEEPING
None of this is advice for your situation. It is a set of ideas people with real track records tend to repeat.
• Diversify across things that do not fail for the same reason.
• Mind the fees. A small annual cost, repeated for decades, becomes a very large number.
• Review on a schedule, not on a headline. Panic is expensive.
• Automate the good habits. Saving that needs willpower eventually stops.
• Know what you own and why. If you cannot explain a holding in one sentence, study it before adding to it.

WHEN THINGS GO WRONG
Every long career has bad quarters. What matters is how quickly you recover.
• Cut losses early on projects that are not working. Sunk cost is not a strategy.
• Keep moving on the next small step. Momentum is a cure for doubt.
• Remember the long game. One chapter does not define the whole book.
• Revisit your assumptions. The market may have changed while you were not looking.
• Rest on purpose. Exhaustion makes every problem look bigger.

QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK
What is the biggest mistake beginners make?
Spending early profits on lifestyle, or switching strategies every few weeks before anything has time to compound.

Is there a single habit that separates wealthy people?
No single one, but long time horizons and a bias toward owning assets show up again and again.

Should I quit my job to start a business?
Only you can weigh that. Many founders test the idea on evenings and weekends first, so the move is lower risk.

Tell us the goal you are working toward right now. We read every comment. Follow for new shorts on mindset, money and modern business.

This channel shares educational and motivational content only. Nothing here is financial, legal or investment advice, and all investing and trading carries risk, including the loss of capital.

videos.description:
Because they are.

What would change in your week if you took this line seriously? Watch the clip, then read on for ideas you can try before the weekend is over.

INSIDE THIS LOOP
The footage was cut to the music, one beat per shot. Look out for private jets on the tarmac, a collector's watch drawer, hypercars and exotic sports cars, city towers glowing after dark, superyachts cutting through blue water and a wall of cash. That is the picture. The rest of this page is the process behind it.

MONEY RULES WORTH KEEPING
Simple rules survive stress better than clever ones.
• Review on a schedule, not on a headline. Panic is expensive.
• Write down your rules while you are calm, and follow them when you are not.
• Pay for expertise when the stakes are high. A good accountant or lawyer usually earns their fee.
• Spend less than you earn, then widen the gap. Everything else is built on that margin.

SKILLS THAT PAY FOR LIFE
Treat learning as an investment with a return, not a hobby.
• Basic finance. Reading a statement and a cash flow forecast removes a lot of fear.
• Learning fast. Break any topic into parts, practise the hard part first and get feedback early.
• Sales. Every founder is selling something, whether they call it that or not.
• Hiring and delegating. Your ceiling is the quality of the people you trust.

THE NETWORK EFFECT OF PEOPLE
Doors open through people far more often than through applications.
• Surround yourself with people a step or two ahead. Standards are contagious.
• Share what you are building in public. Opportunities find people who are visible.
• Learn how to ask a sharp question. Busy people answer clear, specific messages.
• Keep your word on small things. Reliability is the foundation of every big deal.

MONEY, MARKETS AND RISK
Be wary of anyone promising certainty. Markets move on information nobody has yet, and even professionals are wrong often. What separates good investors is process: clear criteria for buying, clear criteria for selling, and a calm review of mistakes. Over many years that discipline matters more than any single clever call.

BUILDING FROM ZERO IN THE AI ERA
E-commerce rewards niche focus. A brand that serves one group extremely well can out-earn a generic store, because customers return, refer friends and accept fair prices. Pair that with clean unit economics, honest marketing and fast support, and a laptop and a good idea become a company with real reach.

DAILY OPERATING HABITS
Nobody needs a perfect routine. They need one they will actually keep.
• Write the day's single priority before bed so the morning starts with a decision already made.
• Batch the shallow work. Email, admin and calls go into fixed windows.
• Train the body. Energy, sleep and mood feed every other metric.
• Protect the first hour. No feeds, no inbox, just training, planning or reading.

LIFESTYLE WITHOUT THE TRAP
Luxury is more enjoyable when it is funded by something solid.
• Let income lead lifestyle, not the other way round.
• Invest in your environment: a good desk, a good bed, a quiet room.
• Set a number for 'enough' and revisit it. Without one the goalposts keep moving.
• Share success with the people who helped. It keeps the whole thing grounded.

A FEW HARD-WON REMINDERS
Before you scroll on, keep these in your back pocket.
• Boring consistency beats occasional brilliance.

videos.title: 70 Cents of Every Dollar Is Over: The Collapse of American Defense Dominance
videos.description:
For decades, Canada sent roughly 70 cents of every military procurement dollar to U.S. defense companies. Now it wants out.

Prime Minister Mark Carney has announced plans to redirect much more defense spending toward Canadian companies, reducing a dependency built over generations. But breaking away from America is far harder than changing where the contracts go.

videos.title: The Fat-Cure Hype Faces COLLAPSE. Tesamorelin Peptide Has a Cancer Warning.
videos.description:
Tesamorelin is being promoted as a peptide that can target the dangerous visceral fat surrounding your organs, but how does it actually work?

Unlike traditional weight-loss drugs, Tesamorelin doesn’t directly suppress appetite or simply burn calories. It mimics Growth Hormone-Releasing Hormone, or GHRH, signaling the pituitary gland to increase the body’s own natural pulses of growth hormone. That matters because visceral fat appears particularly sensitive to growth hormone signaling.
Tesamorelin was originally developed to treat HIV-associated lipodystrophy, a condition that can cause dangerous abdominal fat accumulation in people receiving antiretroviral therapy. In 2010, the FDA approved it under the brand name Egrifta. Clinical trials found that Tesamorelin reduced visceral abdominal fat by roughly 15–20% without necessarily producing dramatic changes on the scale. Research has also explored potential effects on liver fat, metabolic health, inflammation, and even cognitive function. But manipulating the growth hormone axis comes with real trade-offs.
Side effects can include injection-site reactions, joint pain, fluid retention, numbness, changes in glucose tolerance, and increased IGF-1 levels that require monitoring. Brand-name treatment can also cost thousands of dollars per month. And once treatment stops, much of the visceral fat can return.

Tesamorelin may be one of the most clinically validated peptides available, but a smaller waistline can come with a much bigger commitment.

Who is actually buying America’s debt now? For decades, foreign central banks, pension funds, and major banks absorbed huge amounts of U.S. Treasury bonds. But that system is changing.

China has dramatically reduced its holdings, pension funds are moving toward higher-yield investments, and tighter banking regulations have limited how much debt major banks can hold. Into that gap stepped hedge funds. Many are using highly leveraged “basis trades,” buying Treasuries with borrowed money while shorting futures contracts to capture tiny price differences.
By 2025, hedge fund Treasury exposure had grown into the trillions. The problem is that this system depends on stable repo markets and constant access to cheap financing.
If that breaks, funds may be forced to dump Treasuries at the same time, sending bond prices down and yields sharply higher.

America can still sell its debt. The bigger question is who will keep buying it when the leverage stops working.

videos.title: Why the 2022 Car Bubble is Bursting Now
videos.description:
The 2022 car bubble is finally bursting, and millions of Americans are trapped in auto loans worth more than the cars themselves.

During the pandemic-era supply crunch, vehicle production collapsed while demand exploded. Car prices surged to record highs, and buyers increasingly relied on longer loans to make the monthly payments look affordable. Some stretched those loans to 72 or even 84 months. Now the consequences are catching up.
Car values have fallen from their peak, but the debt hasn’t. Millions of drivers are facing negative equity, meaning they owe more on their loan than their vehicle is currently worth. For subprime borrowers, the situation is even worse.
High interest rates, rising living costs, and monthly payments approaching or exceeding $1,000 have pushed delinquencies higher. Repossessions are surging, with 1.73 million vehicles taken back in 2024 alone. The highest level since the aftermath of the Great Recession. And every repossessed vehicle adds another car back into the market. More inventory can push prices lower, creating an even deeper negative-equity trap for borrowers who bought near the top.

The 2022 car boom looked like a new normal. Instead, it may have created one of the biggest auto-loan problems in decades.
